rules.name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)

rules.message: Aged 70 years or above (irrespective of income)
Member of a family already covered under AB PM-JAY (poor and vulnerable families identified in SECC 2011, as later expanded)

benefits.text: Health cover of up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation; all members of eligible families are covered irrespective of age.
People aged 70 or above in families already covered get an additional top-up cover of up to ₹5 lakh per year for themselves.
Other people aged 70 or above get a cover of up to ₹5 lakh per year on a family basis (Ayushman Vay Vandana Card).
The Vay Vandana card covers all pre-existing diseases from the first day, without a waiting period.

how_to_apply.text: People aged 70 or above can register for the Ayushman Vay Vandana Card at the nearest empanelled hospital, or self-register through the Ayushman app or www.beneficiary.nha.gov.in. Helpline: 14555.
People aged 70 or above already in CGHS, ECHS or Ayushman CAPF must choose between their existing scheme and AB PM-JAY; private insurance or ESI does not stop them from using AB PM-JAY.

evidence.quote: With this approval, all senior citizens of the age 70 years and above irrespective of their socio- economic status would be eligible to avail the benefits of AB PM-JAY.

flags.detail: Eligibility for people under 70 depends on official beneficiary lists (SECC 2011 and later expansions), so it is a manual check. The scheme's operational guidelines on pmjay.gov.in / nha.gov.in could not be retrieved (connection failed).
Required documents for enrolment (for example for the Vay Vandana Card) were not stated in the retrieved official sources.

notes: The 70+ expansion was approved by the Cabinet on 11 September 2024 and launched on 29 October 2024.

The Vay Vandana card was described in the 9 December 2024 release as covering around 2000 procedures; the 29 November 2024 release mentions 1961 procedures in the national package. Not used in benefits text.
